commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' So close! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
90+2' 2 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Ramon Terrats and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 2:0.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Charles Pickel (Espanyol) is replacing Urko Gonzalez.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francisco Maeso who sees an offensive foul.
86' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:9. The offside statistics – 3:2.
84' The corner from Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) is cleared away by the defence.
84' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) replacing Exposito.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is coming onto the pitch as Roberto Fernandez Jaen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Marko Dmitrovic leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
82' The resulting corner from Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) comes to nothing. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
81' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

81' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
79' Handball by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
78' A substitution has been made. Unai Gomez goes off and Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
78' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
77' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

74' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Unai Simon with a fabulous save.
74' There's an opportunity for Exposito (Espanyol) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

74' Jofre (Espanyol) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) replaces Jesus Areso.
69' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Carlos Romero plays the ball to the feet of Pere Milla (Espanyol), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 1:0.
69' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:9. 2:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
69' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
67' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
66' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Ath Bilbao get a free kick.
65' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared to safety by the defence.
64' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Substitution. Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) in, Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta out.
63' Substitution. Inaki Williams makes way for Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
63' Here is a change. Antoniu Roca is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Pere Milla (Espanyol).
63' Ruben Sanchez will be replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
61' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
59' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who has already been caught several times today.
56' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Espanyol.
49' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
48' Great teamplay by Espanyol as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
47' The attendance is 29943.
46' Half-time substitution. Ernesto Valverde decided to make a change. Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Yeray Alvarez.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' OFF THE POST! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Exposito (Espanyol) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon was alert and made a comfortable save.
43' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

43' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) picks out Inaki Williams with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
42' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.

39' OFF THE BAR! Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) finds some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a shot that only crashes against the bar! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Marko Dmitrovic. What a save!
39' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) will take the corner.

39' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
36' The resulting corner, taken by Exposito (Espanyol), comes to nothing.
35' Exposito (Espanyol) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Espanyol win a corner.
34' Flag goes up against Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' The corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is hurriedly cleared.

33' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Unai Simon with a brilliant diving save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post.
32' 5:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
31' Exposito (Espanyol) reacts quickest to a cross from Ruben Sanchez, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
29' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
27' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
26' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

25' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) picks out Adama Boiro with a brilliant through ball. A pass into the penalty area from Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
23' Exposito (Espanyol) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
23' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

22' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Espanyol will have an opportunity.
21' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is cleared by the defence.

20' Unai Simon leaps like a salmon to deny Carlos Romero (Espanyol), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
19' What a miskick by Pol Lozano (Espanyol). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
17' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
16' The ball possession is 66:34.
13' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is about to take a corner kick.
13' Marko Dmitrovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) after a cross from the side. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
11' Jesus Areso slings over a decent looking cross towards Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
10' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
9' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
8' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
7' Espanyol control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' What a miskick by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
4' The corner from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence.
3' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
2' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
2' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Espanyol.
1' The first half has started.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
